policy.purpose: Explicit, deny-by-default execution adapter contracts for registered automation programs.
policy.permission_rule: This file never grants GitHub permissions; caller workflow jobs must declare least-privilege permissions.
policy.completion_rule: No task is successful until target completion and independent result verification both pass.
policy.queue_separation: This orchestration contract is separate from rulesets/pending_queue.json.

retry.policy: one initial task; up to two sequential checkpoint-resuming recovery tasks (the second only after execution_timeout and with max_urls<=4); after any independently verified Assessment success, at most one idempotent artifact-recovery task may produce a bounded runner-local artifact batch when no valid immutable source-assessment-output artifact proves the same Discovery predecessor; artifact recovery reuses the exact predecessor proof and durable per-URL checkpoints and is never enqueued when a matching valid artifact already exists; no repository artifact publication

resource_contract.coverage: Only the durable per-URL task assessment_checkpoint in GitHub Issue #423 is shared state. It is updated by append-only Issue snapshot CAS under the active task lease and these two logical resource fences. All assessment JSON and reports are runner-local outputs uploaded as an immutable Actions artifact; no repository file is written or published. Resource lease is 3600 seconds, at least four 15-minute Watchdog reconciliation intervals, so a missed workflow_run event cannot expire the fence before scheduled verification. Both source-DAG capabilities also acquire logical/source-dag-supervision; this common exclusive fence serializes Discovery and Assessment across concurrent Watchdog runs, while Issue #423 CAS and monotonically increasing fencing tokens remain the authority for task claims.

dependency_contract.enforcement: Watchdog downloads the artifact from the exact successful main-branch Shadowrocket Source Discovery (Watchdog) workflow_run, validates the producer run ID/head SHA and complete logical-document digest, confirms equality with current main, then enqueues an idempotent task. The scheduler independently rechecks the current digest before claim.

resource_contract.coverage: The disabled manual selector asserts the exact live resource lease immediately before creating/writing each report output. It is not in the production workflow and remains non-dispatchable until its input/output interface is separately reviewed.

resource_contract.enforcement_boundary: live task-queue proof checked by the audit gate and immediately before publish push
resource_contract.coverage: Exclusive logical/production-pipeline lease plus exact resource keys for the user review cursor, source-discovery checkout outputs, and every published ruleset file. The Watchdog manifest-integrity job serializes with auto_sync through the same shadowrocket-main-writer concurrency group.

retry.policy: one bounded retry only after the exact failed workflow run is independently verified; unresolved dispatch intent is reconciled without redispatch

resource_contract.enforcement_boundary: Exact Watchdog dispatch identity and live logical/source-discovery-run plus logical/source-dag-supervision fencing proofs are asserted before writing to the isolated RUNNER_TEMP workspace; no repository publication is permitted.
resource_contract.coverage: All discovery document, manifest, shard, staging and report writes are confined to the per-run RUNNER_TEMP workspace. The logical lease binds the task/worker and prevents duplicate discovery dispatch; immutable Actions artifact digest and producer identity are independently verified. Resource lease is 3600 seconds, at least four 15-minute Watchdog reconciliation intervals, so a missed workflow_run event cannot expire the fence before scheduled verification. The common logical/source-dag-supervision lease serializes Discovery and Assessment tasks across concurrent Watchdog runs and remains held through independent workflow verification.
